subject: Private deployment commercial options: licensing bundles, retainer vs amortization
content:
From: Procurement Team <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Julio Morales <jmorales@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Private deployment pricing — request for breakdown and amortization examples

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking our call last week. As discussed, we need a clear breakdown of the private deployment commercial model for Arcadia Health so we can run this through procurement and IT approval. Specifically can you provide:

- Line-item for on-prem license (per-site vs per-GPU options)
- Platform fee options (annual amortized vs up-front) and how you price the amortization across 1/3/5 year terms
- Support tiers (SLA targets, response times, on-call hours) and retainer vs included hours examples
- Any migration/implementation credits for a multi-site roll-out

We have a target start window in Q4 and need to present a recommended billing structure + draft SOW to our Finance team by 30 Jul. Attaching our standard procurement questionnaire — happy to jump on a short call to walk through.

Appreciate a sample pricing matrix and an SOW template aligned to the options above.

Regards,
Procurement Team
Arcadia Health
procurement@arcadiahealth.com

-----Original Message-----

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Procurement Team <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Cc: Julio Morales <jmorales@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — request for breakdown and amortization examples

Hi — thanks for the note and timeline. Please find a concise breakdown below; I can send a full matrix and a starter SOW after you confirm which commercial path you prefer (retainer-first or amortized platform fee).

Short answers up-front:
- Licensing model: two main choices
  * Site bundle (preferred for multi-site): flat entitlement per site with a capped GPU allocation per site; priced annually.
  * Node/GPU license: per-GPU pricing for highly elastic edge sites — better if sites scale differently.

- Platform fee:
  * Up-front annual platform fee covers control plane, telemetry retention, and staging images.
  * Amortized option: we can roll the platform fee across 1/3/5 year terms — typical amortization splits are equal annual installments with a 5% discount for 3-year commit, 10% for 5-year commit.

- Support tiers (summary):
  * Standard: business hours, 8x5 response, 24 business-hour P1 SLA.
  * Premium: 24x7, 4-hour P1 response, retainer-based on-call weekends; includes one on-site workshop per year.
  * Enterprise: 24x7 with guaranteed SRE cadence, named SREs, priority engineering queue.

- Migration credits: we typically offer a one-time implementation credit against the platform fee (scaled to commit size). For pilot -> multi-site rollouts we can provide milestone credits tied to site activation.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm preferred licensing basis (site vs node) and expected average throughput per site (tokens/day).
2) I’ll attach a pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx and an initial SOW_Arcadia_draft.pdf for your procurement review.
3) We schedule a 30-minute requirements + procurement call (I have availability Wed/Thu).

I’ve cc’d Mateo from our commercial team to help with pre-approval on discounting/retainer constructs.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), SOW_Arcadia_draft.pdf (pdf stub)

-----Forwarded message-----
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — request for breakdown and amortization examples

Team — forwarding Arcadia’s ask. They want a few amortization examples and clarity on whether we can move platform fee into annual installments and also add a migration credit for the first 3 sites. I’ve proposed standard discounts (5% for 3-year, 10% for 5-year).

Questions for you: do we have headroom to offer a 7.5% one-time commercial credit instead of margin on platform fee if they sign a 36-month commit? Also, if we pivot to a retainer model (annual retainer covers first 250 support hours), can we quote a lower per-token rate for hosted fallbacks during outages?

Thanks — KM

-----Original internal reply-----
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 12:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — request for breakdown and amortization examples

Kim — good context. We have flexibility in credits vs discounting but prefer a structured credit (one-time implementation credit) that does not reduce list price. That preserves PS recognition and keeps renewal anchors intact. I can approve up to 6% commercial credit at my level; anything above 6% needs Markus.

If we do a retainer, we can offer:
- Annual retainer = $75k covering first 250 support hours, after which the hourly rate applies.
- Hosted fallback: we can offer a 25% discounted per-token fallback rate during incident windows if they commit to 36 months.

I’ll attach a quick redline to the pricing matrix and flag the approval bucket.

-Mateo

-----Internal approval reply-----
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private deployment pricing — request for breakdown and amortization examples

I can sign off on a 7.5% one-time commercial credit tied to a 36-month commit, provided we:
- Require the credit to be applied to the platform fee only, not to base license SKUs.
- Lock in a minimum consumption floor for year 1 so we avoid downside.
- Add a clause that hosted fallback pricing is capped to the discounted rate for the first 90 days post-cutover.

Kim — pass this back to Arcadia with the proposed SOW and pricing matrix; call out these commercial guardrails in the SOW.

-Markus

-----Final external reply-----
From: Julio Morales <jmorales@arcadiahealth.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@arcadiahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Private deployment pricing — request for breakdown and amortization examples

Kimberly,

Thanks — the options look sensible and the amortization examples are helpful. Arcadia is comfortable moving forward on the 36-month commit provided we receive the one-time implementation credit applied to the platform fee and the hosted-fallback rate is capped as you outlined. Two quick asks before we route to legal and finance:

1) Can you send the SOW with the credit language and consumption floor called out?
2) We’ll need a PO template for procurement to issue to Redwood and an invoice timing note for how the amortized platform fee will appear on our books.

If you can send the SOW_Arcadia_draft.pdf updated with the guardrails and a PO template we’ll try to complete approvals within two weeks. We’re available Tue/Thu next week for a quick review call.

Regards,
Julio Morales
Director, IT Procurement | Arcadia Health
jmorales@arcadiahealth.com

---
Attachments referenced: pricing_matrix_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SOW_Arcadia_draft.pdf (starter SOW).
